The Mercedes driver was again forced to see off the challenge of a fast-starting Ferrari, with Hamilton eventually finishing third behind Charles Leclerc. Lando Norris was fourth, ahead of Andrea Kimi Antonelli, who was forced to recover from a bad start and taking a 10-second penalty during the Safety Car period. Oscar Piastri was sixth, with Liam Lawson and Oliver Bearman completing the points-paying top eight places.
